source_description: Working detector profile. The prominence boundary was derived from Bike Test 2 and subsequently checked against independently reviewed known-event clips. The detector settings are frozen for study dry-runs unless a real failure mode is demonstrated.

geometry.assumption: one cable-tie click per spoke crossing

reviewed_clips.review_basis: manual listening review; earlier 18-hit note corrected after review

validation.scope_note: These reviewed clips support the current detector settings but are not a large enough validation set to claim a population-level accuracy percentage.

metrics.note: Bike Test 2 supplied the working threshold; independent reviewed clips supplied event-level validation evidence.

notes: WORKING VALIDATED PROFILE. Exact revolution count is not required for calibration. Known physical hit counts are used as independent validation metadata. Geometry must not force detections to a multiple of 36. Keep detector settings fixed during study dry-runs unless a reproducible failure mode is observed.
